method: Serial public API requests. SHA256(qcc-900-v1:username)-ordered members of chessdojo, indices 300-599, with 30+ rapid games and current rapid 750-1100; up to six rated standard rapid games per account from their last three archives, both game ratings 800-1000, at least 50 plies. Stop after 48 games. First eligible games in archive order. No move-quality filtering. All games held out for fresh validation. Fixed plies 12,25,38,49.
